content.text: EnglishEspañol中文 (简体)中文 (繁體)한국어РусскийTiếng ViệtKreyòl ayisyen You pay tax as a percentage of your income in layers called tax brackets. As your income goes up, the tax rate on the next layer of income is higher. When your income jumps to a higher tax bracket, you don't pay the higher rate on your entire income. You pay the higher rate only on the part that's in the new tax bracket. 2025 tax rates for a single taxpayer For a single taxpayer, the rates are: Tax rate on taxable income from . . . up to . . . 10% $0 $11,925 12% $11,926 $48,475 22% $48,476 $103,350 24% $103,351 $197,300 32% $197,301 $250,525 35% $250,526 $626,350 37% $626,351 And up 2025 tax rates for other filers Find the current tax rates for other filing statuses.
